title: Simulated failure rehearsal & comms playbook (WIP)
abstract: Working doc for organizing cross-functional simulated-failure rehearsals tied to canary/A-B rollouts. Focus: exercise detection, human ops, fallback routing, and external comms during model/service regressions and partial infra degradations. Not a final runbook — iterative sketch for quarter 4 rehearsals.
audience: Customer success & GTM lead for affected customers
objectives: Validate end-to-end signals (telemetry -> alert -> oncall -> rollback) within 15 minutes
Confirm fallback routing (hosted -> dedicated -> cheap-variant) triggers and preserves SLA for target cohorts
Practice customer-facing comms for degraded quality or outages
Surface untested dependencies (billing spikes, KV-cache corruption, partial region loss)
Exercise post-rehearsal postmortem cadence and artifact creation
prerequisites: Canary/A-B configuration for the feature with traffic split controls enabled
A dedicated rehearsal window scheduled and approved by PM + SRE lead
Synthetic traffic harness available (deck of prompts + load patterns)
Playback credentials and safe rollback knobs (feature flag, route weight, model pin)
Observation runbook up-to-date (dashboards, alerts, tracing links)
roles: Rehearsal lead: coordinates timeline, calls play start/stop (recommended: PM)
Ops commander: owns runbook steps during simulation and escalations (SRE lead)
Serving engineer: implements injected faults and verifies rollback paths (serving-runtime)
Telemetry engineer: monitors and annotates metrics/dashboards, confirms alert fidelity
CS comms lead: drafts external messaging and customer notes if needed
Legal/security observer: flags compliance/regulatory concerns during sim
scenarios: Model-quality regression: inject a prompt set that triggers hallucination/regression in the canary model variant; observe quality metrics (BLEU-like, classifier rejects, human review sampling)
KV-cache corruption: simulate partial cache invalidation causing higher latency and increased compute; verify autoscaling and cost alarms
Network partition to a region: throttle requests to a region to test multi-region fallback routing and state replication concerns
Latency spike under load: ramp synthetic traffic to simulate sudden p95 jump and validate adaptive batching/fallback behaviors
Billing anomaly: create controlled synthetic token-volume spike to ensure billing alerts and rate-limit fallback activate
Partial model crash: force a worker pool to return errors for a model variant and confirm automatic routing to the next compatible variant
metrics_and_alerts: quality_regression_score_drop > 10% on regression prompt set (alert: RL/quality-signal)
fallback_rate > 5% of requests (metric to watch, trigger for analysis)
alert routing: page SRE on-call -> notify product lead -> IM CS lead
rehearsal_runbook: T-72h: confirm slot & get rehearsal sign-off from PM, SRE, CS. Create rehearsal Jira (RF-XXXX) and invite stakeholders.
T-24h: smoke test synthetic harness, validate dashboards + alert rules are active. Ensure rollback switches tested in staging mirror.
T-1h: announce in #rollout-orchestra and email opt-in observers. Freeze unrelated deploys in rehearsal window.
T0: Rehearsal lead states objective, estimated 30–45 minute window. Ops commander calls 'play start'.
T0+0–5m: Serving engineer injects the fault per scenario (use controlled knobs in rehearsal namespace). Telemetry engineer monitors for first-alert behavior.
T0+5–15m: Verify alerts fire and oncall receives page. Ops commander follows escalation flow: investigate -> apply rollback/fallback -> confirm traffic re-route.
T0+15–30m: CS drafts a customer-safe status message if visible to customers; PM confirms messaging. If rollback successful, confirm metrics returning to baseline.
T0+30–45m: Ops commander declares play complete or transitions to extended mitigation. Annotate timeline in the rehearsal Jira/ticket.
T+24h: Post-rehearsal debrief with artifacts: timeline, actions taken, metrics snapshot, gaps, and owner-assigned follow-ups.
Deliverables: rehearsal Jira ticket, annotated dashboard snapshots, comms drafts, and a short retro note in Confluence
comms_templates:
Internal all-hands ping (short):
  [SUBJECT] Rehearsal: simulated canary degradation starting now (30m).
  [BODY] We are running a scheduled simulated-failure for rollout RF-XXXX to validate fallback routing and comms. Expect transient alerts. Observers: @sre @product @cs. Please avoid unrelated deploys to the canary namespace until sign-off.

Customer-facing (email/console) draft if visible degradation: 
  Hi <CustomerName>,
  We observed a temporary degradation affecting feature <X> during a controlled rehearsal. We routed traffic to a safe variant and restored normal service within 15 minutes. No user data loss. We're following up with a postmortem. Contact support@redwood.ai for questions.
  Regards, CS Team

Post-rehearsal summary (short): 
  Outcome: rollback/fallback worked as designed.
  Time to detection: 4m. Time to mitigation: 9m.
  Follow-ups: update alert thresholds, improve synthetic prompt coverage (owner: Priya), test fallback for caching path (owner: Miguel).

Escalation chat script (for pages): 
  SRE oncall: 'Investigating elevated gen error rate for canary/variant-A. Rehearsal RF-XXXX in progress. Ops commander @<name> taking lead. Will route to variant-B if errors persist beyond 5 minutes.'
post_rehearsal_actions: Create consolidated timeline and attach dashboard snapshots to RF-XXXX
Assign remediation tickets for gap items (owner + due date) in the rollout project board
Update the canary configuration cookbook with any newly discovered rollback steps
Increase synthetic prompt coverage for quality guardrails (add 20 edge-case prompts)
Run a second, smaller rehearsal focusing only on fallback routing within 2 weeks
open_questions: How to safely simulate KV-cache corruption without risking shared infra? (options: rehearsal namespace vs. dedicated mock service)
Do we need a legal-approved customer notification template for regulated customers? Assign legal reviewer.
Should billing anomaly sims be throttled to prevent real cost impact to cloud provider billing alerts? (finance input required)
Can we automate annotation of rehearsal timeline into the incident logging system to avoid manual copy/paste?
What minimum telemetry retention window is required for post-rehearsal analysis (90 days? 365 days?)
